blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Governor Pamela Baricuatro was elated by the strong support of the province’s cities and municipalities during the opening ceremony of the Governor’s Cup U-18 Basketball Tournament 2026 on Sunday, September 27. The opening brought together more than 600 young players representing 44 cities and municipalities, with their mayors and local officials also showing their support. It took place in the newly renovated Mandaue City Sports and Cultural Complex For Baricuatro, the strong turnout was more than just a successful opening.
